items.html: Know that all the couplings that there are in ZON, all of them require that ZON receive influx and illumination from the ten Sefirot of AA, and by this power they can couple. But all the couplings are not equal: for on weekdays, ZA receives his illumination from the Netzah of AA, and all the aspects of ZA are included in the right line, in the Netzah of AA; and Malchut receives her illumination from the Hod of AA, and all her aspects are included in the left line, the Hod of AA; and by this, ZON are not equal as one.
